summary: Python 3.5 added the typing module for type hints (PEP 484), async/await syntax (PEP 492), and the @ operator for matrix multiplication. The os.scandir() function improved directory iteration performance. Coroutines became first-class with native async def and await. Type hints enabled gradual typing and tooling like mypy.
notes: Unsupported since 2020-09-30. Last micro 3.5.10. Full support ended 2017-08-08. async/await made asyncio far more ergonomic and sparked widespread adoption.
